name: Kangbo Yangtze River Bridge
facts: Kangbo Yangtze River Bridge, once called Hejiang Bridge 2, spans 1,715 metres across the Yangtze, making it one of Sichuan’s longest highway crossings.
Each of its twin pylons rises 208 metres, the tallest in Sichuan, showcasing a record‑setting cable‑stayed design that dominates the regional skyline.
Situated just 10 kilometres west of the Bosideng Bridge, Kangbo links the G93 Chengdu–Chongqing Ring Expressway, boosting traffic flow between Chengdu and Chongqing.
